_about: PROTOTYPE (overnight run). The World Plays Here's Sheet variants; see .scratch/v1-launch/overnight/TOOLS.md. Ids WA–WC (not A–C: those are shared bodies, TOOLS.md §1).

WA.name: Entry board: brief beside the key frame with loop, subway and shelter tiles, the shortlist struck through on scroll, four numbered build frames, a media plan table

WB.name: Brand book: mark / line / colour / frame as a numbered spec spread, the slogans as a ballot with one green cross, a snag-to-fix ledger, placements stacking on scroll

WC.name: Orbit: the loop as a planet with eight placements on its orbit, the slogans as a fanned hand, the build as a circle cut in four, the grade as a drag-to-compare
